title: Jury service
summary: This page provides information about jury service in New South Wales, including how to check if you need to attend and how to apply to be excused.

internal_links.text: Apply to be excused from jury service
Check if you need to attend jury service
Find out about jury service in NSW

faqs.q: How do I find out if I need to attend jury service?
faqs.a: You can check if you need to attend jury service using the dedicated NSW Service website.

faqs.q: How do I apply to be excused from jury service?
faqs.a: You can apply to be excused from jury service via the NSW Service website.

faqs.q: Where can I find general information about jury service in NSW?
faqs.a: The NSW Service website has a page dedicated to finding out about jury service in NSW.
